review: mechanical-food-separation@1 adds one general operation, mechanical-food-separation (learning 3, 0.2 energy per study round), registered last for this run's scope, with modes inspect, trial, inspect-progress, resume and cancel, operation open, cut or peel, and parameters inputStackId, quantity (0.1-1 in tenths), implementId and supportId, exact identities through the shared resolver. Reuse: casingResources of ex23 crack-and-separate-casing@1 derives the two part materials from the ex20 HAZELNUT_COMPOSITION exactly as ex23 does (each part's unit is that part of one whole hazelnut unit: kernel 0.08 kg carrying all of the unit's nutrition, toxicity and decay lifetime, shell 0.12 kg with no food value and no decay), under the new ids hazelnut-freed-kernel and hazelnut-shell-fragments; ex23's 0.1 work blocks for fractional stacks, its damage law (nothing at or below the shell strength, else (load - strength) / strength kept on the item, open at 1), its scratch-rule contact wear (0.0001 kg per contact for a striker no harder than what it meets or a support softer by 0.5, the striker following through onto the support after a fracture) and its exact ledger are re-applied because they are closures inside its factory; SAMPLE_OPENING_LAWS of ex20 open-and-separate-sample@1 supply the transmission law (strength hardness / 10 times 1 - flexibility, the lower of implement and support), the bounded bare-hand load (the hand-break-food@1 force over the represented unit mass) and the deterioration classes; thinSliceEdgeProblem of ex19 thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1, the rule cutting-edge-assessment@1 reports (stone or flint, index 8 and at least the food's, radius at most 0.0002, sound, whole), decides the edge, and ex19's slicing law (cutting keeps mass, food value and age, no offcut) the cut; the shared ex19 material-contact module supplies the piece, contact, ground and light checks; the result agrees with ex17 mechanical-food-handling@1 (harder food needs an implement); the ex18 unheated-food-preparation@1 look reports the live visible condition; probe (handler open.probe, foundation-open@1) is only a comparison and its press is not used as fracture; every earlier package, these included, is byte-identical by an id@version hash assertion. A bout is a paid setup round (0.2) that checks food, operation, quantity, means, reach and energy for the whole bout (0.7) and reserves the exact portion without copying it (the item itself when all of it is selected, else exact tenths split as collective-work reserves), storing item, material facts, quantity, operation, means, paid phase and prior damage, then the working round in the next round of the same action (0.5); inspect and inspect-progress cost one round and 0.2 and use no food; cancel costs one round and no energy; every refusal (other items, not food, other treatments, spoiled food, peel, open without a shell, cut of a shell or of less than a whole unit, other quantities, missing or unsuitable means, out of reach, too little energy) comes before any cost. Modeling assumptions: open applies only where a shell is represented (hazelnut); a working round gives each 0.1 block of the portion, at most ten, one squeeze or impact and picks opened blocks apart by hand in the same round, so 0.9 hazelnut is nine blocks and one bout works at most one unit; the bare-hand load spreads the bounded hand force over one represented unit, not over a block, because tenths are accounting portions of one unit's material rather than smaller shells, so the bare hand stays below the hazelnut shell's strength and a hand bout ends as resisted with the item unchanged; an implement is one own carried whole rigid sound inedible unit held in the hand, the support a solid unreserved inedible object in reach that is not a plant or animal, or another own piece on firm ground where the person stands; all blocks of one bout share one outcome; each opened block gives 0.1 kernel and 0.1 shell with the source origin, harvest round and decay and no debris, while damaged blocks stay closed with the crack on the item and a later bout adds to it; cut applies to one whole unit of food without a represented shell, needs an edge and a support, makes one stroke per working round and keeps the unit one item of the same food whose record counts portions (at most 10) and cut surfaces, because eat, give and drop take whole units, so cutting it into fractional items would strand the food; the edge meets the food and then follows through onto the support, so a stone edge on a stone outcrop wears 0.0001 kg per stroke and soft food adds no wear; no implement or support fractures; no geometry, inner layer, peel or skin is represented for any food, so peel is refused and inspect reports why; light limits only what the interior observation shows; the personal records of each response are unverified. Lifecycle: another action, lost reach or means, or energy below 0.5 pause before the working round without charge, and resume rechecks the exact portion, its recorded damage and the means and does the unpaid working round; a changed or missing portion ends the work as invalidated and releases what is left once; death ends it and releases the portion once to the death rules; products and returned portions keep ageing under the ordinary rules; nothing is refunded. No reward: no satisfaction rule, no qualified flag on any event, no top-level progress, elapsed or remaining number, unverified records only, and no object is made. Visuals: no components; every event carries view metadata (actor, exact input, portion and output ids, operation, means, location, paid phase, phase, contact only when performed, visible change, products only when they exist, outcome, reason and no badge). In this world Lin carries no implement and no flint is represented anywhere; the stone outcrop start-1-stone, about 6.3 units from Lin, can be reached by walking and gathered as a stone unit, which then serves as striker or edge with the outcrop as the support.
